classification: First script path in the wrapped command. API=build/hosted.mjs; native_build=build/native.py; runtime_pair=native-pair.py or native-pair-streamed.py; observation=request/control/oracle/admission/events/qualification/diff/transport-probe/erased-capture/quality-screen; other includes checked-plan capture/replay and profiler-runtime construction.
scope: Sum of terminal guard wallSeconds, including successful and failed commands. Guarded execution-lane time only: not CPU-seconds, agent time, billing/quota, elapsed research time, or total compute. Nested build phases and qualification cases are not separately added. Observations include hosted compiler requests and metadata diff jobs. RSS is the maximum/median of sampled per-process-tree peaks, never a sum of memory consumption. Unfinished or missing receipts are excluded from time sums.
